name: Lilyvale Solar Farm
current_developer: Lilyvale Asset Co Pty Ltd ATF Lilyvale Asset Trust
notable: 170 MW solar farm near Emerald, Central Queensland. Developed by FRV (Abdul Latif Jameel). Holds a PPA with CleanCo Queensland.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Lilyvale Solar Farm — EPBC referral (not a controlled action, 5 Jan 2015) & Central Highlands Regional Council DA (9 Sep 2015)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: New Powerlink 132 kV substation on Lilyvale–Blackwater 132 kV line
eis_specs.connection_augmentation: New Powerlink 132 kV substation and short spur transmission line built early 2019
eis_specs.notes: Fotowatio Renewable Ventures (FRV). 100 MWac / 126 MWdc; single-axis-tracking PV, 50 km NE of Emerald in Central QLD. EPBC 'not a controlled action' Jan 2015; Central Highlands Regional Council DA approved Sep 2015. Financial close Sep 2017; Ergon Energy PPA. Powerlink substation and 132 kV connection asset completed early 2019.
